name_cn: Codex 主导的可见真实用户旅程验收
principle: GPT freezes; Codex independently designs and executes the acceptance journey; GPT only adjudicates the returned evidence.

GPT: 发布一条面向 Codex 的验收任务
不得预先替 Codex 选择具体业务测试样例
收到 Codex 证据后只做最终裁决
CODEX: 独立选择一个最小但有效的真实使用样例
优先选择极简、低副作用、结果容易核验的任务
通过正式用户路径执行，不调用隐藏函数或测试捷径代替
记录屏幕可见链路与真实结果
明确 PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED 与失败来源
USER: 除正式产品路径需要的人类动作外，不介入测试逻辑

criteria: 足够简单，能快速达到虚拟成熟
能覆盖 自动Freeze→完整Reality Dispatch→真实执行→返回GPT
副作用小且可回滚/可验证
业务结果有明确可核验终点
不依赖测试专用字段或隐藏入口

highest_acceptance_path: Codex independently chooses a small production-isomorphic task
Codex executes/observes the same visible path a user would use
Codex records whether GPT automatically reaches complete REAL dispatch without user reminder
Codex executes the resulting task in the real environment
Codex returns evidence and result to GPT
forbidden: Codex only runs unit/regression scripts and calls that release evidence
Codex repairs product mid-run then continues same run as PASS
User reminds GPT to continue or send command
release_pass_conditions: Codex independently selected the acceptance task
The tested path was production-isomorphic and user-visible
A complete Codex Reality command was actually produced
The real task was actually executed and its result verified
The full evidence returned to GPT without hidden repair
